title: Pearl 99 nights
features:
​🌲 99 Nights in the Forest | Ultimate Automated Script 🌲

​Dominate the wilderness and survive every single night effortlessly with this feature-rich, fully optimized script. Designed for maximum efficiency, safety, and combat dominance!

​⚔️ Combat & Kill Features

​Auto Bring & Kill Enemies: Automatically teleports all nearby mobs directly to you and eliminates them instantly.

​Kill Aura: Automatically attacks any hostile creature that gets within your vicinity.

​Safe Mode: Smart toggles to prevent bans and keep your farming looking natural to other players.

​🍎 Automation & Survival

​Bring Item: Instantly pulls valuable items and resources across the map directly to your inventory.

​Auto Cook All Meat: Automatically cooks every piece of meat available on the map—no manual campfire waiting required!

​Auto Eat Food: Keeps your hunger bar fully optimized so you never starve.

​Teleport to Campfire: Instantly escape danger or warm up by teleporting to the nearest campfire.

​🕊️ Movement & Exploits

​Walkspeed Slider: Customize your movement speed exactly how you want it.

​Jump Height Slider: Adjust your jump power to scale mountains and obstacles with ease.

​No Clip: Walk straight through trees, rocks, and walls.

​Fly: Take to the skies to scout the forest or avoid ground threats completely.

​👁️ Visuals & Utility

​ESP Mobs: See the exact location of every enemy through walls and across long distances.

​Anti-AFK: Prevents Roblox from disconnecting you, allowing you to farm resources overnight.
